limitations: Only constant-field extensions of F5(t) are classified. No claim on arbitrary base changes, threefold cohomology, or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_integrity: The specific new calculation is an explicit primitive section and exact finite-constant-field Galois descent, not a new general geometric Mordell-Weil classification. The proof assumes the established rationality and Kodaira fiber types of the initiating surface. Priority beyond inspected sources is not certified.
title: An explicit primitive section and quadratic constant-field descent for a characteristic-five elliptic surface
